name: Release Offline
description: Schema 9 protocol for the Interviewer release test's offline-readiness journey, which imports it from a file while the device is offline and conducts it there. Its assets are the paths an offline import has to save on the device: an image shown on an information stage and a roster read from a network asset, searched through a worker.

content.en-US:
# Release offline

This protocol was imported while the device was offline.
